response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang skills, but the role demands native-level Japanese, deep C/UNIX proficiency, Linux kernel source modification experience, and embedded networking security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching) — none of which are evidenced. His only substantive C/C++ work was a brief 7-month stint in 2014-2015, and his listed languages (English, Romanian, German) do not include Japanese, a hard requirement.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured software development career spanning web, mobile, desktop, and some embedded contexts
Experience with low-latency, high-throughput systems (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency — a mandatory native-level requirement
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation/modification or embedded firmware development experience
No background in networking security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF) or LAN-switch products
